title: [main][Gen. Jnl.-Post Line]` Add var NextVATEntryNo to OnAfterGLFinishPosting in Code
summary: The OnAfterGLFinishPosting event in codeunit 12 "Gen. Jnl.-Post Line" now passes NextVATEntryNo as a var parameter. Subscribers can read and change the next VAT entry number after G/L posting finishes. The change is made in every localization layer.
key_points: OnAfterGLFinishPosting now exposes NextVATEntryNo as a var parameter
Applied to Gen. Jnl.-Post Line in the W1, APAC, BE, CH, ES, FI, FR, IT, NA, NO and RU layers
Subscribers can read or change the next VAT entry number
